study: Prospective independent-pilot conditional-risk screening vs frozen witness plain race
status: locked before all comparative simulation on this new cohort
prehistory: 10% R, 10% C at random without replacement; uncontrolled 2 time units; one unconditioned attempt, retain extinctions
portfolio: rumor-degree top-4 anchor; seven one-swap alternatives replace its last target by next ranked outside node, degree/id deterministic ties
randomization: Method order randomized within context; sequential timing; race seed stream shared across methods for variance reduction, separate phase coordinates for pilot and confirmations. Each method executes and pays for all its own paths; no caching across methods. Phase-local round IDs keep unmodified-race tapes aligned.
accounting: Online wall and CPU include common presolve, routing, pilots, tests, simulation, validation and trace collection; exclude graph generation, prehistory, compilation and compression. Pilot four tapes = eight marginal copies. Independent evaluation remains 256 paths/action on every context.
stopping: Exactly 32 new graphs x 3 natural histories; one new frozen policy and no outcome-driven reruns or changes. Every graph, history and unfavorable outcome is reported.
primary: plain/adaptive_screen: conditional pilot-routed screen versus frozen strong unscreened witness race
multiplicity: One planned wall-time contrast; retain the previous conservative central 97.5% graph-family-stratified bootstrap interval, 20000 resamples. No secondary superiority claim. CPU/copies/families and total elapsed time are descriptive.
quality_gate: Every query in both cells certified at epsilon=.1, per-query alpha=.05, common 32768-copy cap; adjusted wall-cost ratio lower bound >1. All 96 contexts retained, including common exact extinction presolve. No conditioning on certificate success.
descriptive: pilot activation and endpoint certification counts
copy and CPU ratios; shared zero-copy presolves contribute a neutral log-copy ratio of zero
power: 32 fixed independent graphs, 8/family. With central 97.5% interval, approximate 80% detectable standardized graph log-cost effect .545. No power claim for rare erroneous certificates or equivalence.
attribution_scope: Pilot choices informed by previous development cohorts; no claim these are optimal. Gating four independent endpoint tapes at sample mean <epsilon/2; if skipped full alpha for race, if enabled alpha*.1 for screen and alpha*.9 for fresh fallback. Pilot never contributes to confirmation. The plain comparator is the frozen previous witness_plain implementation, not a weakened baseline.
budget_scope: Same common cap 32768 as the preceding witness-refinement cohort; no further budget increase. Pilot, endpoint and candidate copies all charged. Report <=16384 prefix counts descriptively.
preprocessing: Both cells use identical exact rumor-extinction presolve (no R initially implies zero future rumor). Its measured wrapper cost is included. All extinctions are retained, never discarded; zero continuation count is an exact result.
sequence_scope: This interval concerns this new policy and cohort only, not simultaneous protection across the entire prior research sequence. Previous unsuccessful screening contrasts remain reported.
